title: Mitchell and Uri Geller; Svahn meets Geller

tellings.quote: Now we talked a lot about he met Yori

plain: Clas Svahn, a longtime UFO researcher who keeps a large archive, says he spoke at length with Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who walked on the Moon, about Mitchell's meeting with Uri Geller, a performer famous for claiming psychic powers such as bending spoons. Svahn says he met Geller himself too. The story matters to those who think an astronaut took psychic abilities seriously.
